wrong: The number of international students applying for scholarships have risen sharply.
correct: The number of international students applying for scholarships has risen sharply.
ruleVi: 'The number of + danh từ số nhiều' luôn đi với động từ số ít ('has risen').

wrong: A large proportion of household budgets are spent on rent in major cities.
correct: A large proportion of household budgets is spent on rent in major cities.
ruleVi: Chủ ngữ chính là 'A large proportion' (hoặc phần không đếm được), nên chia động từ số ít 'is spent'.

wrong: Each of the proposed climate policies require substantial public funding.
correct: Each of the proposed climate policies requires substantial public funding.
ruleVi: 'Each of + danh từ số nhiều' luôn chia động từ số ít ('requires').

wrong: Neither the municipal council nor local businesses has approved the toll plan.
correct: Neither the municipal council nor local businesses have approved the toll plan.
ruleVi: Với 'Neither A nor B', động từ chia theo chủ ngữ gần nhất ('local businesses' -> số nhiều 'have approved').

wrong: The rapid expansion of online retail, combined with rising rents, have forced many shops to close.
correct: The rapid expansion of online retail, combined with rising rents, has forced many shops to close.
ruleVi: Chủ ngữ chính là 'The rapid expansion' (số ít); cụm 'combined with...' không làm chủ ngữ thành số nhiều.

wrong: Investing heavily in early childhood education yield measurable long-term returns.
correct: Investing heavily in early childhood education yields measurable long-term returns.
ruleVi: Danh động từ làm chủ ngữ ('Investing...') luôn đi với động từ số ít ('yields').

wrong: There is several compelling reasons why urban cycling should be subsidised.
correct: There are several compelling reasons why urban cycling should be subsidised.
ruleVi: Danh từ đứng sau là 'several compelling reasons' (số nhiều) nên phải dùng 'There are'.

wrong: One of the most pressing challenges facing cities today are air pollution.
correct: One of the most pressing challenges facing cities today is air pollution.
ruleVi: Chủ ngữ chính là 'One' (số ít) trong 'One of the most pressing challenges...', nên động từ là 'is'.

wrong: The percentage of graduates working remotely have doubled since 2019.
correct: The percentage of graduates working remotely has doubled since 2019.
ruleVi: 'The percentage of...' làm chủ ngữ luôn đi với động từ số ít ('has doubled').

wrong: Everybody who commutes during peak hours know how stressful gridlock can be.
correct: Everybody who commutes during peak hours knows how stressful gridlock can be.
ruleVi: Đại từ bất định 'Everybody / Everyone' luôn chia động từ số ít ('knows').

wrong: Modern hospitals rely on advanced medical equipments to diagnose patients early.
correct: Modern hospitals rely on advanced medical equipment to diagnose patients early.
ruleVi: 'equipment' là danh từ không đếm được, không bao giờ thêm -s.

wrong: Governments must provide clearer informations about how personal data is stored.
correct: Governments must provide clearer information about how personal data is stored.
ruleVi: 'information' không đếm được; muốn đếm phải dùng 'pieces of information'.

wrong: Recent researches indicate that green spaces significantly lower urban stress.
correct: Recent research indicates that green spaces significantly lower urban stress.
ruleVi: 'research' là danh từ không đếm được nên không thêm -s và chia động từ số ít ('indicates').

wrong: University advisors offer valuable advices on career planning and internships.
correct: University advisors offer valuable advice on career planning and internships.
ruleVi: 'advice' không đếm được; không thêm -s hay dùng 'an advice'.

wrong: Tourists frequently struggle to find affordable accommodations near the city centre.
correct: Tourists frequently struggle to find affordable accommodation near the city centre.
ruleVi: Trong tiếng Anh Anh chuẩn IELTS, 'accommodation' là danh từ không đếm được.

wrong: The study highlights a dramatic rise in the amount of private cars on city roads.
correct: The study highlights a dramatic rise in the number of private cars on city roads.
ruleVi: 'cars' là danh từ đếm được số nhiều nên phải dùng 'the number of', không dùng 'the amount of'.

wrong: Less commuters used the suburban rail line after ticket prices increased.
correct: Fewer commuters used the suburban rail line after ticket prices increased.
ruleVi: Dùng 'Fewer' với danh từ đếm được số nhiều ('commuters'), không dùng 'Less'.

wrong: Too many traffic during rush hour increases both fuel waste and stress.
correct: Too much traffic during rush hour increases both fuel waste and stress.
ruleVi: 'traffic' là danh từ không đếm được nên phải đi với 'too much'.

wrong: The new curriculum gives students practical knowledges about personal finance.
correct: The new curriculum gives students practical knowledge about personal finance.
ruleVi: 'knowledge' là danh từ không đếm được, không dùng ở dạng số nhiều 'knowledges'.

wrong: Passengers are permitted to bring two luggages onto the regional coach.
correct: Passengers are permitted to bring two pieces of luggage onto the regional coach.
ruleVi: 'luggage' không đếm được; muốn nêu số lượng phải dùng 'pieces/items of luggage'.

wrong: The society as a whole benefits when public healthcare is universally accessible.
correct: Society as a whole benefits when public healthcare is universally accessible.
ruleVi: Khi nói đến 'xã hội nói chung' (nghĩa khái quát), không dùng mạo từ 'The' trước 'Society'.

wrong: Pollution poses serious threat to marine biodiversity along coastal zones.
correct: Pollution poses a serious threat to marine biodiversity along coastal zones.
ruleVi: Danh từ đếm được số ít 'threat' bắt buộc phải có mạo từ: 'pose a serious threat to'.

wrong: A number of European nations have invested heavily in an renewable energy.
correct: A number of European nations have invested heavily in renewable energy.
ruleVi: 'renewable' bắt đầu bằng phụ âm /r/ và 'energy' là danh từ không đếm được nói chung -> bỏ 'an'.

wrong: According to the chart, the United Kingdom spent more on rail than the France.
correct: According to the chart, the United Kingdom spent more on rail than France.
ruleVi: Không dùng mạo từ 'the' trước tên quốc gia số ít như France, Japan, Vietnam (chỉ dùng với the UK, the US, the Netherlands).

wrong: Students who study abroad gain valuable experience and an unique cultural outlook.
correct: Students who study abroad gain valuable experience and a unique cultural outlook.
ruleVi: 'unique' phát âm bắt đầu bằng âm phụ âm /j/ (/juːˈniːk/), nên phải dùng 'a unique', không phải 'an'.

wrong: The internet has become indispensable tool for modern academic research.
correct: The internet has become an indispensable tool for modern academic research.
ruleVi: Danh từ số ít 'tool' cần mạo từ 'an' trước nguyên âm /ɪ/ của 'indispensable'.

wrong: Many graduates aspire to work in European Union after completing their master's degree.
correct: Many graduates aspire to work in the European Union after completing their master's degree.
ruleVi: Các khối liên minh có danh từ chung như Union, Kingdom, States bắt buộc có 'the'.

wrong: Government should invest more in vocational training for unemployed youth.
correct: The government should invest more in vocational training for unemployed youth.
ruleVi: 'Government' ở dạng số ít đếm được cần mạo từ 'The government' (hoặc dùng số nhiều 'Governments').

wrong: Honest discussion is essential; it took over a hour to reach an agreement.
correct: Honest discussion is essential; it took over an hour to reach an agreement.
ruleVi: Chữ 'h' trong 'hour' là âm câm (/ˈaʊə/), nên phải dùng mạo từ 'an hour'.

wrong: Excessive screen exposure has a negative impact to children's sleep quality.
correct: Excessive screen exposure has a negative impact on children's sleep quality.
ruleVi: Collocation chuẩn luôn là 'have an impact/effect ON something', không dùng 'to'.

wrong: In my opinion, parents are largely responsible of monitoring their children online.
correct: In my opinion, parents are largely responsible for monitoring their children online.
ruleVi: Cấu trúc chuẩn là 'be responsible FOR + N/V-ing'.

wrong: The essay will discuss about the economic benefits of remote employment.
correct: The essay will discuss the economic benefits of remote employment.
ruleVi: 'discuss' là ngoại động từ đi thẳng với tân ngữ, KHÔNG thêm giới từ 'about'.

wrong: Many rural clinics suffer a chronic shortage of qualified medical staff.
correct: Many rural clinics suffer from a chronic shortage of qualified medical staff.
ruleVi: Cụm động từ chuẩn khi nói chịu đựng khó khăn/thiếu hụt là 'suffer FROM'.

wrong: High-speed rail offers an eco-friendly alternative than short-haul domestic flights.
correct: High-speed rail offers an eco-friendly alternative to short-haul domestic flights.
ruleVi: 'alternative' luôn đi với giới từ 'to' ('an alternative to X').

wrong: Public libraries play a vital role in providing equal access for digital resources.
correct: Public libraries play a vital role in providing equal access to digital resources.
ruleVi: Danh từ 'access' luôn đi với giới từ 'to' ('access to education/resources').

wrong: Despite of strict speed limits, road accidents remain common during wet weather.
correct: Despite strict speed limits, road accidents remain common during wet weather.
ruleVi: 'Despite' KHÔNG bao giờ đi kèm 'of' (chỉ 'In spite of' mới có 'of').

wrong: Urban temperatures rose sharply between 1990 to 2020 across southern Europe.
correct: Urban temperatures rose sharply between 1990 and 2020 across southern Europe.
ruleVi: Cặp giới từ chuẩn là 'between X AND Y' hoặc 'from X TO Y', tuyệt đối không trộn 'between... to'.

wrong: Young workers often struggle to cope up with soaring metropolitan housing costs.
correct: Young workers often struggle to cope with soaring metropolitan housing costs.
ruleVi: Cụm đúng là 'cope with' (đối phó với); không có từ 'up' ở giữa.

wrong: According to me, subsidising renewable power is the wisest long-term strategy.
correct: In my view, subsidising renewable power is the wisest long-term strategy.
ruleVi: Trong tiếng Anh học thuật không dùng 'According to me'; dùng 'In my view,' hoặc 'From my perspective,'.

wrong: Although renewable energy is initially costly, but it saves money in the long run.
correct: Although renewable energy is initially costly, it saves money in the long run.
ruleVi: Trong tiếng Anh không dùng đồng thời cả 'Although' lẫn 'but' trong cùng một câu.

wrong: Public transport is affordable, however, many residents still prefer private cars.
correct: Public transport is affordable; however, many residents still prefer private cars.
ruleVi: 'however' là trạng từ liên kết, không nối hai mệnh đề độc lập chỉ bằng dấu phẩy (lỗi comma splice); phải dùng dấu.

wrong: Because of air pollution is worsening, several cities have introduced low-emission zones.
correct: Because air pollution is worsening, several cities have introduced low-emission zones.
ruleVi: 'Because of' chỉ đi với cụm danh từ; trước một mệnh đề có chủ-vị phải dùng 'Because'.

wrong: While working from home reduces commuting time. It can weaken team cohesion.
correct: While working from home reduces commuting time, it can weaken team cohesion.
ruleVi: 'While + mệnh đề' là mệnh đề phụ, không được tách thành câu độc lập (lỗi sentence fragment).

wrong: Because traffic congestion wastes hours daily, so employers should allow flexible start times.
correct: Because traffic congestion wastes hours daily, employers should allow flexible start times.
ruleVi: Không dùng đồng thời cả 'Because' và 'so' trong cùng một câu.

wrong: Even though the high tuition fees, demand for overseas degrees continues to climb.
correct: Despite the high tuition fees, demand for overseas degrees continues to climb.
ruleVi: 'Even though' cần một mệnh đề đầy đủ; trước cụm danh từ 'the high tuition fees' phải dùng 'Despite'.

wrong: The reason why obesity is rising is because processed food is cheap and convenient.
correct: The reason why obesity is rising is that processed food is cheap and convenient.
ruleVi: Tránh lặp nghĩa 'The reason ... is because'; cấu trúc chuẩn là 'The reason ... is that...'.

wrong: Not only the new metro line eases congestion, but it also lowers carbon emissions.
correct: Not only does the new metro line ease congestion, but it also lowers carbon emissions.
ruleVi: Khi 'Not only' đứng đầu câu, bắt buộc phải đảo ngữ: 'Not only + does/do/did + S + V nguyên thể'.

wrong: Many graduates lack practical skills, therefore, universities should expand internships.
correct: Many graduates lack practical skills; therefore, universities should expand internships.
ruleVi: Tránh lỗi comma splice với 'therefore': dùng dấu chấm phẩy trước và dấu phẩy sau ('; therefore,').

wrong: Whether cities expand bike lanes or not depend largely on political willpower.
correct: Whether cities expand bike lanes or not depends largely on political willpower.
ruleVi: Mệnh đề danh ngữ 'Whether...' làm chủ ngữ luôn chia động từ số ít ('depends').

wrong: Expanding rural broadband can significant improve access to university courses.
correct: Expanding rural broadband can significantly improve access to university courses.
ruleVi: Cần trạng từ 'significantly' để bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'improve', không dùng tính từ 'significant'.

wrong: Governments must take decisive act to protect coastal wetlands from erosion.
correct: Governments must take decisive action to protect coastal wetlands from erosion.
ruleVi: Collocation chuẩn là 'take decisive action' (danh từ không đếm được 'action').

wrong: The economic of renewable energy has shifted dramatically over the past decade.
correct: The economics of renewable energy has shifted dramatically over the past decade.
ruleVi: 'economics' (danh từ, chia số ít) chỉ khía cạnh/bài toán kinh tế; 'economic' chỉ là tính từ.

wrong: Electric scooters provide a very economy way to travel short urban distances.
correct: Electric scooters provide a very economical way to travel short urban distances.
ruleVi: 'economical' nghĩa là tiết kiệm chi phí; khác với 'economic' (thuộc nền kinh tế) và danh từ 'economy'.

wrong: Long working hours can have a harm effect on parents' relationships with children.
correct: Long working hours can have a harmful effect on parents' relationships with children.
ruleVi: Trước danh từ 'effect' cần tính từ 'harmful', không dùng danh từ/động từ 'harm'.

wrong: Rapid urbanisation has led to the destroy of valuable agricultural land.
correct: Rapid urbanisation has led to the destruction of valuable agricultural land.
ruleVi: Sau mạo từ 'the' và trước 'of' phải dùng danh từ 'destruction'.

wrong: Regular exercise is extreme beneficial for both physical stamina and mood.
correct: Regular exercise is extremely beneficial for both physical stamina and mood.
ruleVi: Bổ nghĩa cho tính từ 'beneficial' phải dùng trạng từ 'extremely'.

wrong: A lack of sleep can make drivers feel tiring and slow their reaction speed.
correct: A lack of sleep can make drivers feel tired and slow their reaction speed.
ruleVi: Tính từ mô tả cảm xúc con người dùng đuôi -ed ('tired'), không dùng -ing ('tiring' mô tả vật/việc gây mệt).

wrong: Schools should teach students how to evaluate online news sources critical.
correct: Schools should teach students how to evaluate online news sources critically.
ruleVi: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'evaluate' cần trạng từ 'critically'.

wrong: Between 2000 and 2010, the price of wheat raised sharply from $120 to $260 per tonne.
correct: Between 2000 and 2010, the price of wheat rose sharply from $120 to $260 per tonne.
ruleVi: 'rise' là nội động từ (tự tăng -> quá khứ 'rose'); 'raise' là ngoại động từ cần tân ngữ đi sau.

wrong: The proportion of solar power was increased from 4% in 2010 to 19% in 2020.
correct: The proportion of solar power increased from 4% in 2010 to 19% in 2020.
ruleVi: Động từ mô tả xu hướng số liệu như increase, rise, fall, drop dùng ở dạng chủ động, không dùng bị động.

wrong: By 2035, electric vehicle sales are expecting to surpass petrol models.
correct: By 2035, electric vehicle sales are expected to surpass petrol models.
ruleVi: Dự báo tương lai ở Task 1 phải dùng bị động 'be expected/projected to + V'.

wrong: In 1995, the unemployment rate was stood at 8.5% before falling gradually.
correct: In 1995, the unemployment rate stood at 8.5% before falling gradually.
ruleVi: 'stand at' là nội động từ không bao giờ chia bị động ('stood at', không phải 'was stood at').

wrong: Over the twenty-year period, coal usage fell dramatically to 30% to 10%.
correct: Over the twenty-year period, coal usage fell dramatically from 30% to 10%.
ruleVi: Diễn tả điểm bắt đầu và kết thúc của sự thay đổi dùng 'from X to Y'.

wrong: The number of museum visitors peaked in 4.2 million in July 2019.
correct: The number of museum visitors peaked at 4.2 million in July 2019.
ruleVi: Động từ 'peak' luôn đi với giới từ 'at' trước con số ('peaked at 4.2 million').

wrong: In 2015, Japan spent 20 percents of its energy budget on wind turbines.
correct: In 2015, Japan spent 20 percent of its energy budget on wind turbines.
ruleVi: 'percent' không bao giờ thêm -s khi đi sau con số ('20 percent' hoặc '20%').

wrong: The chart illustrates the amount of households owning electric bicycles since 2015.
correct: The chart illustrates the number of households owning electric bicycles since 2015.
ruleVi: 'households' đếm được nên phải dùng 'the number of households'.

wrong: There was a significantly increase in online grocery orders during 2020.
correct: There was a significant increase in online grocery orders during 2020.
ruleVi: Trước danh từ 'increase' phải là tính từ 'significant', không dùng trạng từ 'significantly'.

wrong: The figure for France was twice higher than that for Italy in 2018.
correct: The figure for France was twice as high as that for Italy in 2018.
ruleVi: So sánh gấp đôi không dùng 'twice higher than'; cấu trúc chuẩn là 'twice as high as'.

wrong: The new recycling plant was built in 2018 and has been operate smoothly ever since.
correct: The new recycling plant was built in 2018 and has operated smoothly ever since.
ruleVi: 'operate' mang nghĩa vận hành chủ động ở đây -> dùng thì hiện tại hoàn thành 'has operated'.

wrong: Higher fuel taxes can discourage motorists to drive into congested city centres.
correct: Higher fuel taxes can discourage motorists from driving into congested city centres.
ruleVi: Cấu trúc bắt buộc của 'discourage' là 'discourage sb FROM + V-ing'.

wrong: Subsidised rail passes encourage commuters switching from private cars to trains.
correct: Subsidised rail passes encourage commuters to switch from private cars to trains.
ruleVi: 'encourage + O + to V' (khác với 'discourage + O + from V-ing').

wrong: The municipal council suggested to expand evening bus services along outer routes.
correct: The municipal council suggested expanding evening bus services along outer routes.
ruleVi: Động từ 'suggest' đi với V-ing ('suggested expanding') hoặc 'suggest that + S + V', KHÔNG dùng 'suggest to V'.

wrong: Strict workplace laws prevent employers to underpay part-time university staff.
correct: Strict workplace laws prevent employers from underpaying part-time university staff.
ruleVi: Cấu trúc chuẩn là 'prevent + O + FROM + V-ing'.

wrong: Many developing regions cannot afford building high-speed rail networks independently.
correct: Many developing regions cannot afford to build high-speed rail networks independently.
ruleVi: 'afford' luôn đi với động từ nguyên thể có to ('afford to V').

wrong: The workshop enabled graduate students developing practical data visualisation skills.
correct: The workshop enabled graduate students to develop practical data visualisation skills.
ruleVi: Cấu trúc chuẩn là 'enable + O + to V'.

wrong: After the raw timber is shredded, it is transport to a heated drying chamber.
correct: After the raw timber is shredded, it is transported to a heated drying chamber.
ruleVi: Thể bị động bắt buộc dùng phân từ quá khứ V3/ed ('is transported').

wrong: Public parks, that provide vital cooling in summer, deserve greater municipal funding.
correct: Public parks, which provide vital cooling in summer, deserve greater municipal funding.
ruleVi: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định (có dấu phẩy) TUYỆT ĐỐI không dùng 'that'; phải dùng 'which'.

wrong: Students which graduate with strong digital skills tend to secure employment faster.
correct: Students who graduate with strong digital skills tend to secure employment faster.
ruleVi: Thay thế cho chủ ngữ chỉ người ('Students') phải dùng 'who' (hoặc 'that'), không dùng 'which'.

wrong: Remote work cuts daily commuting time, what significantly improves family wellbeing.
correct: Remote work cuts daily commuting time, which significantly improves family wellbeing.
ruleVi: Đại từ quan hệ thay thế cho cả mệnh đề đứng trước là ', which', không dùng ', what'.

wrong: The city where I visited last autumn has transformed its waterfront into a park.
correct: The city that I visited last autumn has transformed its waterfront into a park.
ruleVi: 'visit' là ngoại động từ cần tân ngữ trực tiếp -> dùng 'that/which I visited', không dùng 'where'.

wrong: Small firms whose revenues fell sharply during the crisis received emergency grants, which helped it survive.
correct: Small firms whose revenues fell sharply during the crisis received emergency grants, which helped them survive.
ruleVi: Danh từ quy chiếu là 'Small firms' (số nhiều) nên đại từ phải là 'them', không phải 'it'.

wrong: The policy applies to all residents who their annual income falls below the threshold.
correct: The policy applies to all residents whose annual income falls below the threshold.
ruleVi: Diễn đạt quan hệ sở hữu trong mệnh đề quan hệ dùng 'whose + danh từ'.

wrong: There are many online platforms in where learners can practise spoken English.
correct: There are many online platforms where learners can practise spoken English.
ruleVi: 'where' đã bao hàm giới từ ('in which'); không bao giờ viết 'in where'.

wrong: The report highlights several cities in Europe which public transport is entirely free.
correct: The report highlights several cities in Europe in which public transport is entirely free.
ruleVi: Mệnh đề sau đã đủ chủ-vị-bổ ngữ ('public transport is free') nên cần 'where' hoặc 'in which'.

wrong: If governments would invest more in preventative care, hospital costs would decline.
correct: If governments invested more in preventative care, hospital costs would decline.
ruleVi: Trong mệnh đề 'If' của câu điều kiện loại 2 chỉ dùng quá khứ đơn ('invested'), không dùng 'would'.

wrong: Had cities upgraded flood barriers earlier, the coastal damage would not be so severe last year.
correct: Had cities upgraded flood barriers earlier, the coastal damage would not have been so severe last year.
ruleVi: Sự việc xảy ra 'last year' (quá khứ) nên vế chính điều kiện loại 3 phải là 'would not have been'.

wrong: Seldom policymakers confront a challenge as complex as demographic ageing.
correct: Seldom do policymakers confront a challenge as complex as demographic ageing.
ruleVi: Trạng từ phủ định 'Seldom' đứng đầu câu bắt buộc đảo trợ động từ: 'Seldom do policymakers confront'.

wrong: Only when consumers change their habits will companies to adopt sustainable packaging.
correct: Only when consumers change their habits will companies adopt sustainable packaging.
ruleVi: Sau động từ khuyết thiếu 'will' là động từ nguyên thể không to ('adopt').

wrong: Were tuition fees to be abolished completely, university budgets will face severe shortfalls.
correct: Were tuition fees to be abolished completely, university budgets would face severe shortfalls.
ruleVi: 'Were ... to V' là đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 2, nên vế chính phải dùng 'would + V', không dùng 'will'.

wrong: Unless strict emission targets are not enforced, industrial pollution will keep rising.
correct: Unless strict emission targets are enforced, industrial pollution will keep rising.
ruleVi: 'Unless' bản thân đã mang nghĩa phủ định ('If ... not'), nên tuyệt đối không thêm 'not' phía sau.

wrong: Never before the global economy has been so closely interconnected.
correct: Never before has the global economy been so closely interconnected.
ruleVi: Cụm phủ định 'Never before' đứng đầu câu bắt buộc đảo 'has' lên trước chủ ngữ.

wrong: Should the pilot programme succeeds, the council will expand it to ten districts.
correct: Should the pilot programme succeed, the council will expand it to ten districts.
ruleVi: Trong đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 1 'Should + S + V', động từ chính luôn ở dạng nguyên thể ('succeed').

wrong: Rapid technological change brings a lot of big problems for older workers.
correct: Rapid technological change brings significant challenges for older workers.
ruleVi: Tránh văn nói 'a lot of big problems' trong IELTS Writing; dùng 'significant challenges'.

wrong: Governments must do stronger efforts to curb illegal logging in protected forests.
correct: Governments must make greater efforts to curb illegal logging in protected forests.
ruleVi: Collocation chuẩn của 'effort' là 'make an effort / make efforts', không dùng 'do'.

wrong: Spending excessive time on smartphones can make harm to young people's eyesight.
correct: Spending excessive time on smartphones can cause harm to young people's eyesight.
ruleVi: Dùng 'cause harm to' hoặc 'do harm to', không dùng 'make harm to'.

wrong: Many young graduates struggle to find a high salary job straight after university.
correct: Many young graduates struggle to find a well-paid job straight after university.
ruleVi: Cụm tự nhiên chuẩn bản xứ là 'a well-paid job' hoặc 'a lucrative career'.

wrong: Nowadays, technology is very convenient for students to open their mind.
correct: Nowadays, technology is very convenient for students to broaden their horizons.
ruleVi: Tránh dịch word-by-word từ tiếng Việt ('mở mang đầu óc'); dùng 'broaden their horizons'.

wrong: It is undeniable that urban green spaces bring lots of merits for city dwellers.
correct: It is undeniable that urban green spaces offer numerous benefits to city dwellers.
ruleVi: Tránh 'lots of' và lỗi giới từ; dùng 'offer numerous benefits to'.

wrong: Students should pay more attention on developing critical thinking rather than rote memorisation.
correct: Students should pay greater attention to developing critical thinking rather than rote memorisation.
ruleVi: Collocation cố định là 'pay attention TO', không dùng 'on'.

wrong: In my opinion, parents must take a good example for their children to follow.
correct: In my opinion, parents must set a good example for their children to follow.
ruleVi: Collocation chuẩn để nói 'làm gương tốt' là 'set a good example', không dùng 'take'.

wrong: Electric buses are significantly more quieter and cleaner than diesel fleets.
correct: Electric buses are significantly quieter and cleaner than diesel fleets.
ruleVi: Không dùng so sánh kép 'more' với tính từ ngắn đã thêm -er ('quieter').

wrong: The cost of living in central London is much higher than Manchester.
correct: The cost of living in central London is much higher than that in Manchester.
ruleVi: So sánh phải đồng đẳng: so sánh 'The cost of living' với 'that in Manchester', không so sánh giá cả với thành phố.

wrong: A balanced diet helps improve concentration, boosting immunity, and sleep quality.
correct: A balanced diet helps improve concentration, boost immunity, and enhance sleep quality.
ruleVi: Cấu trúc song song (parallelism): 'improve X, boost Y, and enhance Z' cùng dạng động từ nguyên thể.

wrong: Walking to work every morning, the air quality felt noticeably fresher along the river.
correct: Walking to work every morning, commuters noticed that the air felt noticeably fresher along the river.
ruleVi: Lỗi dangling modifier: 'Walking to work' phải bổ nghĩa cho chủ ngữ là con người ('commuters'), không phải 'the air quality'.

wrong: Solar panels are now far more cheaper to install than they were fifteen years ago.
correct: Solar panels are now far cheaper to install than they were fifteen years ago.
ruleVi: Không ghép 'more' với 'cheaper'; chỉ dùng 'far cheaper'.

wrong: Online platforms allow learners to study flexibly, saving commute time, and access global lectures.
correct: Online platforms allow learners to study flexibly, save commute time, and access global lectures.
ruleVi: Đảm bảo song song sau 'allow learners to': 'study..., save..., and access...'.

wrong: Compared with the older generation, young adults' digital literacy is far higher.
correct: Compared with the older generation, young adults possess far higher digital literacy.
ruleVi: Sau 'Compared with the older generation,', chủ ngữ mệnh đề chính phải là con người ('young adults'), không phải 'digital literacy'.

wrong: This scheme is not only beneficial for rural farmers but also urban consumers.
correct: This scheme is beneficial not only for rural farmers but also urban consumers.
ruleVi: Cấu trúc song song 'not only ... but also': đặt 'not only' ngay trước 'for rural farmers' để cân với 'but also (for) urban consumers'.

wrong: Government should invest heavily in public transport infrastructure.
correct: The government should invest heavily in public transport infrastructure.
ruleVi: Danh từ đếm được số ít "government" cần mạo từ "the" (hoặc dùng số nhiều "governments").

wrong: In the modern society, digital literacy is essential for employment.
correct: In modern society, digital literacy is essential for employment.
ruleVi: Không dùng "the" trước "society" khi nói về xã hội nói chung.

wrong: Internet has fundamentally transformed how students conduct academic research.
correct: The internet has fundamentally transformed how students conduct academic research.
ruleVi: Luôn dùng mạo từ "the" trước "internet" trong văn viết học thuật chuẩn.

wrong: Protecting environment should be a top priority for every municipality.
correct: Protecting the environment should be a top priority for every municipality.
ruleVi: Khi nói về môi trường tự nhiên nói chung, bắt buộc dùng "the environment".

wrong: Many graduates struggle to find a stable employment after leaving university.
correct: Many graduates struggle to find stable employment after leaving university.
ruleVi: "Employment" là danh từ không đếm được nên không đi với mạo từ "a".

wrong: The education plays a decisive role in reducing long-term poverty.
correct: Education plays a decisive role in reducing long-term poverty.
ruleVi: Không dùng "the" trước danh từ trừu tượng nói chung như "education".

wrong: Elderly often face serious barriers when accessing online banking services.
correct: The elderly often face serious barriers when accessing online banking services.
ruleVi: Cấu trúc "the + tính từ" ("the elderly") để chỉ một nhóm người trong xã hội.

wrong: Majority of urban commuters prefer reliable underground trains over buses.
correct: The majority of urban commuters prefer reliable underground trains over buses.
ruleVi: Luôn dùng "the majority of" khi nói về đa số một nhóm đối tượng.

wrong: University degree is no longer an automatic guarantee of high earnings.
correct: A university degree is no longer an automatic guarantee of high earnings.
ruleVi: Danh từ đếm được số ít "university degree" cần mạo từ "a" (phát âm bắt đầu bằng /j/).

wrong: Public libraries provide an useful quiet space for low-income learners.
correct: Public libraries provide a useful quiet space for low-income learners.
ruleVi: "Useful" phát âm bắt đầu bằng phụ âm /j/ nên phải dùng mạo từ "a", không dùng "an".

wrong: Climate change poses serious threat to low-lying coastal farmland.
correct: Climate change poses a serious threat to low-lying coastal farmland.
ruleVi: Cụm collocation chuẩn đếm được số ít phải có mạo từ: "pose a serious threat to".

wrong: Modern hospitals require expensive medical equipments to treat complex diseases.
correct: Modern hospitals require expensive medical equipment to treat complex diseases.
ruleVi: "Equipment" là danh từ không đếm được, tuyệt đối không thêm "-s".

wrong: Online platforms often distribute unreliable informations during election campaigns.
correct: Online platforms often distribute unreliable information during election campaigns.
ruleVi: "Information" không đếm được; muốn đếm phải dùng "pieces of information".

wrong: Several academic researches confirm that green roofs reduce urban heat.
correct: Several academic studies confirm that green roofs reduce urban heat.
ruleVi: "Research" không đếm được trong văn học thuật chuẩn; hãy dùng "studies" cho số nhiều.

wrong: Expanding public transports is essential to curb downtown traffic emissions.
correct: Expanding public transport is essential to curb downtown traffic emissions.
ruleVi: Trong Anh-Anh, "public transport" không đếm được và không thêm "-s".

wrong: Teachers should offer constructive feedbacks rather than relying solely on grades.
correct: Teachers should offer constructive feedback rather than relying solely on grades.
ruleVi: "Feedback" là danh từ không đếm được, không dùng dạng số nhiều "feedbacks".

wrong: Excessive homeworks can deprive primary pupils of vital outdoor play.
correct: Excessive homework can deprive primary pupils of vital outdoor play.
ruleVi: "Homework" không đếm được; nếu cần số nhiều hãy dùng "homework assignments".

wrong: Urban noise causes severe damages to residents' sleep quality over time.
correct: Urban noise causes severe damage to residents' sleep quality over time.
ruleVi: "Damage" (thiệt hại) không đếm được; "damages" chỉ dùng cho tiền bồi thường pháp lý.

wrong: Many international student struggle to adapt to independent university essays.
correct: Many international students struggle to adapt to independent university essays.
ruleVi: Sau lượng từ "many", danh từ đếm được bắt buộc phải chia ở dạng số nhiều ("students").

wrong: Rising sea levels are a global phenomena affecting coastal cities worldwide.
correct: Rising sea levels are a global phenomenon affecting coastal cities worldwide.
ruleVi: "Phenomenon" là số ít đi với "a"; "phenomena" là dạng số nhiều.

wrong: Universities apply strict admission criterion when awarding merit scholarships.
correct: Universities apply strict admission criteria when awarding merit scholarships.
ruleVi: Không có mạo từ "a" và mang nghĩa nhiều tiêu chí nên phải dùng số nhiều "criteria".

wrong: Expanding affordable childcare facilities help more parents re-enter the workforce.
correct: Expanding affordable childcare facilities helps more parents re-enter the workforce.
ruleVi: Chủ ngữ là cụm danh động từ ("Expanding...") luôn chia động từ ngôi thứ ba số ít ("helps").

wrong: The rapid growth of budget airlines have accelerated tourism emissions.
correct: The rapid growth of budget airlines has accelerated tourism emissions.
ruleVi: Danh từ trung tâm chủ ngữ là "growth" (số ít), nên động từ phải là "has accelerated".

wrong: Neither stricter fines nor a wider motorway alone solve chronic rush-hour gridlock.
correct: Neither stricter fines nor a wider motorway alone solves chronic rush-hour gridlock.
ruleVi: Với "Neither A nor B", động từ chia theo chủ ngữ gần nó nhất ("a wider motorway" -> "solves").

wrong: Each of the participating schools receive annual grants for science labs.
correct: Each of the participating schools receives annual grants for science labs.
ruleVi: "Each of + danh từ số nhiều" luôn đi với động từ chia số ít ("receives").

wrong: High levels of urban air pollution poses grave risks to infants.
correct: High levels of urban air pollution pose grave risks to infants.
ruleVi: Chủ ngữ chính là "levels" (số nhiều) nên động từ phải chia số nhiều ("pose").

wrong: A growing proportion of university graduates works remotely for overseas firms.
correct: A growing proportion of university graduates work remotely for overseas firms.
ruleVi: "A proportion of + danh từ số nhiều" chia động từ theo danh từ số nhiều ("work").

wrong: Public investment in libraries and parks benefit the entire local community.
correct: Public investment in libraries and parks benefits the entire local community.
ruleVi: Chủ ngữ chính là "investment" (số ít không đếm được), nên động từ phải là "benefits".

wrong: There is several compelling reasons to subsidise regional commuter rail networks.
correct: There are several compelling reasons to subsidise regional commuter rail networks.
ruleVi: Trong cấu trúc "There + be", động từ chia theo danh từ phía sau ("reasons" -> "are").

wrong: Every citizen and local business bear responsibility for cutting plastic waste.
correct: Every citizen and local business bears responsibility for cutting plastic waste.
ruleVi: Chủ ngữ bắt đầu bằng "Every..." luôn chia động từ ở dạng số ít ("bears").

wrong: The main drawback of remote apprenticeships are limited hands-on supervision.
correct: The main drawback of remote apprenticeships is limited hands-on supervision.
ruleVi: Chủ ngữ chính là "drawback" (số ít), không phải "apprenticeships", nên dùng "is".

wrong: Between 2000 and 2020, renewable electricity output has tripled across Europe.
correct: Between 2000 and 2020, renewable electricity output tripled across Europe.
ruleVi: Khoảng thời gian đã kết thúc hoàn toàn trong quá khứ ("2000–2020") phải dùng quá khứ đơn.

wrong: Since 2015, municipal recycling rates rose steadily in most northern cities.
correct: Since 2015, municipal recycling rates have risen steadily in most northern cities.
ruleVi: Với "since + mốc quá khứ" kéo dài đến hiện tại, dùng hiện tại hoàn thành ("have risen").

wrong: By 2040, electric passenger cars will replace most petrol vehicles in Europe.
correct: By 2040, electric passenger cars will have replaced most petrol vehicles in Europe.
ruleVi: "By + mốc tương lai" trong Task 1 ưu tiên thì tương lai hoàn thành ("will have replaced").

wrong: In 1990, coal was accounting for nearly half of national power generation.
correct: In 1990, coal accounted for nearly half of national power generation.
ruleVi: Số liệu thống kê cố định tại một năm trong quá khứ dùng quá khứ đơn ("accounted"), không dùng tiếp diễn.

wrong: If governments invested more in rail earlier, traffic jams would be smaller now.
correct: If governments had invested more in rail earlier, traffic jams would be smaller now.
ruleVi: Điều kiện hỗn hợp (nguyên nhân trái quá khứ -> kết quả hiện tại) dùng "had + V3" ở mệnh đề If.

wrong: Last year, the ministry announces a five-year plan to modernise rural clinics.
correct: Last year, the ministry announced a five-year plan to modernise rural clinics.
ruleVi: Trạng ngữ thời gian quá khứ xác định ("Last year") bắt buộc chia động từ quá khứ đơn.

wrong: Over the past decade, urban rents increase much faster than average wages.
correct: Over the past decade, urban rents have increased much faster than average wages.
ruleVi: "Over the past decade" chỉ quá trình đến hiện tại, phải dùng hiện tại hoàn thành ("have increased").

wrong: Policy papers must emphasise on preventive healthcare rather than emergency surgery.
correct: Policy papers must emphasise preventive healthcare rather than emergency surgery.
ruleVi: Động từ "emphasise" là ngoại động từ trực tiếp, KHÔNG đi với giới từ "on".

wrong: This essay will discuss about the economic impacts of remote working.
correct: This essay will discuss the economic impacts of remote working.
ruleVi: Động từ "discuss" đi trực tiếp với tân ngữ, không thêm "about" như dịch từ tiếng Việt.

wrong: Despite of higher fuel taxes, private car ownership continued to expand.
correct: Despite higher fuel taxes, private car ownership continued to expand.
ruleVi: Dùng "despite + N" hoặc "in spite of + N"; tuyệt đối không viết "despite of".

wrong: Chronic air pollution is extremely detrimental for children's cognitive development.
correct: Chronic air pollution is extremely detrimental to children's cognitive development.
ruleVi: Tính từ "detrimental" luôn đi với giới từ "to" ("detrimental to sth").

wrong: Public transport must remain accessible for elderly and low-income residents.
correct: Public transport must remain accessible to elderly and low-income residents.
ruleVi: Tính từ "accessible" chuẩn học thuật đi với giới từ "to" ("accessible to sb").

wrong: Expanding early screening can contribute to reduce long-term hospital expenditure.
correct: Expanding early screening can contribute to reducing long-term hospital expenditure.
ruleVi: Sau "contribute to", "to" là giới từ nên bắt buộc dùng V-ing ("reducing") hoặc danh từ.

wrong: Many graduates lack of the practical workplace skills required by employers.
correct: Many graduates lack the practical workplace skills required by employers.
ruleVi: Động từ "lack" không có "of" ("lack skills"); chỉ danh từ mới dùng "a lack of".

wrong: Authorities must find a sustainable solution for inner-city traffic congestion.
correct: Authorities must find a sustainable solution to inner-city traffic congestion.
ruleVi: Danh từ "solution" chuẩn collocation đi với giới từ "to" ("solution to a problem").

wrong: Developing nations should invest heavily into vocational engineering colleges.
correct: Developing nations should invest heavily in vocational engineering colleges.
ruleVi: Động từ "invest" luôn đi với giới từ "in", không dùng "into".

wrong: Public attitudes with renewable energy have shifted positively over recent years.
correct: Public attitudes towards renewable energy have shifted positively over recent years.
ruleVi: Danh từ "attitude" đi với giới từ "towards" hoặc "to", không dùng "with".

wrong: Electric buses are cleaner, however, their upfront purchase cost remains high.
correct: Electric buses are cleaner; however, their upfront purchase cost remains high.
ruleVi: Không nối 2 mệnh đề độc lập bằng ", however," (lỗi comma splice); phải dùng chấm phẩy hoặc chấm câu.

wrong: Urban rents have soared recently, therefore many young workers commute long distances.
correct: Urban rents have soared recently; therefore, many young workers commute long distances.
ruleVi: "Therefore" là trạng từ nối, cần dấu chấm phẩy hoặc chấm câu trước nó để tránh lỗi run-on.

wrong: Online courses expand access to education they cannot fully replace campus mentorship.
correct: Online courses expand access to education, yet they cannot fully replace campus mentorship.
ruleVi: Hai mệnh đề độc lập viết liền nhau không dấu câu/liên từ là lỗi run-on; cần thêm liên từ hoặc chấm câu.

wrong: Although renewable energy costs have fallen sharply over the past decade.
correct: Although renewable energy costs have fallen sharply over the past decade, grid storage remains expensive.
ruleVi: Mệnh đề phụ bắt đầu bằng "Although" không thể đứng một mình làm câu hoàn chỉnh (lỗi fragment).

wrong: Because urban congestion wastes millions of productive working hours every year.
correct: Urban congestion requires urgent rail investment because it wastes millions of productive working hours every year.
ruleVi: Mệnh đề nguyên nhân bắt đầu bằng "Because" phải gắn với một mệnh đề chính.

wrong: Whereas private cars carry only one or two passengers during rush hour.
correct: A single tram can carry two hundred commuters, whereas private cars carry only one or two passengers.
ruleVi: "Whereas" chỉ nối hai mệnh đề tương phản trong cùng một câu, không đứng tách riêng thành câu.

wrong: Especially young graduates who lack savings for a residential property deposit.
correct: Soaring rents hit renters hard, especially young graduates who lack savings for a property deposit.
ruleVi: Cụm danh từ bắt đầu bằng "Especially..." không có động từ chính nên là câu cụt (fragment).

wrong: Which makes affordable public childcare essential for modern dual-income households.
correct: Living costs have risen sharply, which makes affordable public childcare essential for dual-income households.
ruleVi: Mệnh đề quan hệ bắt đầu bằng "Which" phải nối sau dấu phẩy của mệnh đề trước, không tách thành câu riêng.

wrong: Such as stricter vehicle emission caps, wider cycle lanes, and cleaner buses.
correct: Cities can deploy practical measures, such as stricter emission caps, wider cycle lanes, and cleaner buses.
ruleVi: Cụm liệt kê bắt đầu bằng "Such as" không có chủ ngữ và động từ chính (lỗi fragment).

wrong: Reducing household electricity consumption and lowering winter heating bills significantly.
correct: Better roof insulation helps families by reducing electricity consumption and lowering winter heating bills.
ruleVi: Cụm phân từ V-ing đứng một mình thiếu chủ ngữ và động từ chia thì là câu cụt.

wrong: For example, free school lunches, community clinics, and subsidised commuter passes.
correct: Several public programmes aid low-income families, for example free school lunches and subsidised commuter passes.
ruleVi: Sau "For example," đầu câu độc lập phải là mệnh đề đủ chủ - vị, không chỉ liệt kê danh từ.

wrong: Even though international climate agreements set ambitious long-term carbon targets.
correct: Even though international climate agreements set ambitious targets, domestic enforcement often lags behind.
ruleVi: Mệnh đề nhượng bộ với "Even though" bắt buộc phải có mệnh đề chính đi kèm.

wrong: While automation eliminates certain repetitive clerical tasks in modern offices.
correct: While automation eliminates repetitive clerical tasks, it also creates demand for technical maintenance roles.
ruleVi: Mệnh đề phụ bắt đầu bằng "While" không được đứng độc lập như một câu hoàn chỉnh.

wrong: Having invested heavily in vocational apprenticeships and modern engineering colleges.
correct: Having invested heavily in vocational apprenticeships, Germany enjoys relatively low youth unemployment.
ruleVi: Cụm phân từ hoàn thành "Having + V3" ở đầu câu bắt buộc phải có mệnh đề chính theo sau.

wrong: To address widening regional disparities in hospital staffing and diagnostic equipment.
correct: To address widening regional disparities in hospital staffing, ministries must fund rural medical scholarships.
ruleVi: Cụm động từ nguyên mẫu chỉ mục đích ("To address...") không thể đứng một mình không có mệnh đề chính.

wrong: Not only expanding underground rail lines across densely populated outer suburbs.
correct: Planners are not only expanding underground rail lines but also building protected suburban cycleways.
ruleVi: Cụm "Not only + V-ing" thiếu chủ ngữ và vế "but also" tạo thành câu cụt.

wrong: Students who rely heavily on passive highlighting rather than active recall.
correct: Students who rely heavily on passive highlighting rather than active recall often forget material quickly.
ruleVi: Chủ ngữ có mệnh đề quan hệ ("who rely...") nhưng bị bỏ quên động từ chính của cả câu.

wrong: Despite the clear long-term economic benefits of preventive public healthcare.
correct: Despite the clear economic benefits of preventive healthcare, budgets often favour emergency hospitals.
ruleVi: Cụm giới từ "Despite + NP" phải nối với một mệnh đề chính bằng dấu phẩy.

wrong: Given the rapid proliferation of unverified health advice on short-video apps.
correct: Given the proliferation of unverified advice online, schools must prioritise critical media literacy.
ruleVi: Cụm phân từ "Given + NP" không phải câu hoàn chỉnh khi thiếu mệnh đề chính theo sau.

wrong: Whether national universities should abolish tuition fees for domestic undergraduates.
correct: Policymakers continue to debate whether national universities should abolish tuition fees for domestic undergraduates.
ruleVi: Mệnh đề danh ngữ bắt đầu bằng "Whether..." không thể đứng một mình làm câu hoàn chỉnh.

wrong: In addition to lowering municipal landfill volumes and methane gas emissions.
correct: In addition to lowering landfill volumes, household composting produces nutrient-rich soil for urban parks.
ruleVi: Cụm giới từ "In addition to + V-ing" cần một mệnh đề chính đi kèm phía sau.

wrong: Rapid urbanisation combined with underfunded public sanitation and ageing water pipes.
correct: Rapid urbanisation combined with underfunded sanitation has strained freshwater supplies across growing megacities.
ruleVi: Cụm danh từ dài có phân từ "combined with" nhưng thiếu hoàn toàn động từ chính được chia thì.

wrong: Young people without job prospects are more likely to make a crime.
correct: Young people without job prospects are more likely to commit a crime.
ruleVi: Lỗi dịch sát từ "phạm/làm tội"; collocation chuẩn bắt buộc là "commit a crime".

wrong: Students should learn knowledge from both classroom lectures and real-world projects.
correct: Students should acquire knowledge from both classroom lectures and real-world projects.
ruleVi: Không nói "learn knowledge" trong tiếng Anh học thuật; dùng "acquire/gain knowledge".

wrong: Social media algorithms can make a big effect on teenagers' self-esteem.
correct: Social media algorithms can have a profound effect on teenagers' self-esteem.
ruleVi: Tránh dịch sát "tạo ảnh hưởng lớn"; dùng "have a profound/significant effect on".

wrong: Schools must increase awareness about recycling among primary school pupils.
correct: Schools must raise awareness of recycling among primary school pupils.
ruleVi: Collocation chuẩn Band 8 là "raise awareness of" (không dùng "increase... about").

wrong: Coal power plants make heavy pollution across surrounding residential valleys.
correct: Coal power plants cause severe pollution across surrounding residential valleys.
ruleVi: Không dùng "make pollution"; collocation tự nhiên là "cause/generate severe pollution".

wrong: Large corporations must do responsibility for recycling their own plastic packaging.
correct: Large corporations must shoulder responsibility for recycling their own plastic packaging.
ruleVi: Lỗi dịch từ "làm trách nhiệm"; dùng "shoulder/take/assume responsibility for".

wrong: Regular physical exercise helps elderly adults destroy unhealthy sedentary habits.
correct: Regular physical exercise helps elderly adults break unhealthy sedentary habits.
ruleVi: Với thói quen không dùng "destroy"; collocation chuẩn là "break a habit".

wrong: Municipal governments should do strict measures to curb downtown congestion.
correct: Municipal governments should implement stringent measures to curb downtown congestion.
ruleVi: Không dùng "do measures"; phải dùng "take/implement/adopt stringent measures".

wrong: Universities should make research about affordable desalination technologies.
correct: Universities should conduct research into affordable desalination technologies.
ruleVi: Không nói "make research"; collocation chuẩn học thuật là "conduct/carry out research into".

wrong: Prolonged smartphone addiction puts a serious harm to adolescent sleep.
correct: Prolonged smartphone addiction poses a serious threat to adolescent sleep.
ruleVi: Sai động từ và danh từ đếm được; chuẩn Band 8 là "pose a serious threat to" hoặc "do serious harm to".

wrong: Unpaid internships make wider the wealth gap between rich and poor graduates.
correct: Unpaid internships widen the wealth gap between rich and poor graduates.
ruleVi: Dùng động từ trực tiếp "widen the gap" thay cho cách dịch từng chữ "make wider".

wrong: Rising housing prices make high pressure on young working families.
correct: Rising housing prices place immense pressure on young working families.
ruleVi: Không dịch sát "tạo áp lực cao"; dùng "place/exert immense pressure on".

wrong: A lot of people think that governments should spend tons of money on green energy.
correct: Many people argue that governments should allocate substantial funding to green energy.
ruleVi: "Tons of money" quá suồng sã (văn nói); Task 2 học thuật dùng "substantial funding".

wrong: Kids nowadays spend way too much time staring at smartphones after school.
correct: Children today spend excessive amounts of time using smartphones after school.
ruleVi: "Kids" và "way too much" thuộc văn nói thân mật; bài viết học thuật dùng "children" và "excessive".

wrong: Building more metro lines is a really great idea to fix traffic jams.
correct: Expanding metro networks is a highly effective strategy for alleviating traffic congestion.
ruleVi: "Really great idea" và "fix traffic jams" quá thông tục cho văn phong IELTS Academic.

wrong: Fast food is super bad for people's health and makes them get fat.
correct: Fast food is highly detrimental to public health and contributes to rising obesity.
ruleVi: "Super bad" và "get fat" quá suồng sã; dùng "detrimental to health" và "obesity".

wrong: In this day and age, technology has changed everything in our daily lives.
correct: In contemporary society, technology has transformed key aspects of daily life.
ruleVi: "In this day and age" là cụm sáo rỗng (cliché) cần tránh trong Writing Task 2 Band 7.5+.

wrong: Every coin has two sides when we look at working from home.
correct: Remote working presents both distinct advantages and notable drawbacks.
ruleVi: Tránh thành ngữ sáo rỗng "every coin has two sides"; nêu trực tiếp ưu và nhược điểm.

wrong: Governments shouldn't ignore climate change because it's a huge deal.
correct: Governments should not neglect climate change because it poses a grave long-term threat.
ruleVi: Tránh viết tắt ("shouldn't", "it's") và tiếng lóng ("huge deal") trong bài luận Academic.

wrong: Many folks in big cities are totally fed up with noisy construction sites.
correct: Many urban residents are increasingly frustrated by persistent construction noise.
ruleVi: "Folks" và "totally fed up with" mang sắc thái văn nói; dùng "urban residents" và "frustrated by".

wrong: Online scammers rip off elderly citizens who aren't tech-savvy.
correct: Online fraudsters routinely exploit elderly citizens who lack digital literacy.
ruleVi: "Rip off" là cụm động từ lóng; văn viết trang trọng dùng "exploit" hoặc "defraud".

wrong: Public schools need better stuff like modern labs and updated textbooks.
correct: Public schools require upgraded facilities such as modern laboratories and current textbooks.
ruleVi: "Stuff" quá mơ hồ và thông tục; dùng danh từ chính xác như "facilities" hay "equipment".

wrong: Tourism brings in loads of cash for historic coastal towns every summer.
correct: Tourism generates substantial revenue for historic coastal towns every summer.
ruleVi: "Loads of cash" thuộc văn nói; trong IELTS Writing dùng "substantial revenue".

wrong: Young graduates often find it pretty tough to buy their first home.
correct: Young graduates often find it considerably challenging to purchase their first home.
ruleVi: "Pretty tough" quá suồng sã; dùng "considerably challenging" hoặc "difficult".

wrong: Cutting trees down messes up wildlife habitats and causes bad floods.
correct: Deforestation disrupts wildlife habitats and intensifies severe seasonal flooding.
ruleVi: "Messes up" là cụm văn nói; văn học thuật dùng "disrupts" hoặc "degrades".

wrong: Universities ought to kick out outdated exams that only test memory.
correct: Universities should phase out outdated examinations that reward rote memorisation.
ruleVi: "Kick out" quá thông tục cho chính sách; dùng "phase out" hoặc "abolish".

wrong: Advertising companies trick shoppers into buying things they don't really need.
correct: Advertising agencies often persuade consumers to purchase unnecessary goods.
ruleVi: "Trick" và viết tắt "don't" thiếu tính khách quan học thuật; dùng "persuade" hoặc "manipulate".

wrong: Working crazy long hours burns out hospital nurses very quickly.
correct: Working excessively long shifts rapidly leads to burnout among hospital nurses.
ruleVi: "Crazy long" là khẩu ngữ; bài viết học thuật dùng "excessively long".

wrong: There are heaps of reasons why public libraries still matter today.
correct: There are numerous compelling reasons why public libraries remain indispensable today.
ruleVi: "Heaps of" là tiếng lóng Anh-Úc; văn viết trang trọng dùng "numerous compelling reasons".

wrong: Politicians need to get their act together and fix ageing railway networks.
correct: Policymakers must act decisively to modernise ageing railway networks.
ruleVi: Thành ngữ khẩu ngữ "get their act together" không phù hợp với văn phong IELTS Writing.

wrong: Some parents are kinda worried about screen addiction among toddlers.
correct: Many parents are understandably concerned about excessive screen use among toddlers.
ruleVi: "Kinda" là khẩu ngữ rút gọn; bắt buộc dùng từ đầy đủ trang trọng như "understandably concerned".

wrong: Plastic rubbish ends up in the ocean and kills off tons of sea creatures.
correct: Plastic waste accumulates in marine ecosystems and threatens countless aquatic species.
ruleVi: "Rubbish", "kills off", và "tons of" kém học thuật hơn "waste", "threatens", "countless".

wrong: The goverment must allocate greater funding to rural healthcare clinics.
correct: The government must allocate greater funding to rural healthcare clinics.
ruleVi: Từ "government" rất hay bị thiếu chữ "n" ở giữa (govern + ment).

wrong: Protecting the enviroment requires binding limits on industrial carbon emissions.
correct: Protecting the environment requires binding limits on industrial carbon emissions.
ruleVi: Từ "environment" luôn có chữ "n" trước "m" (environ + ment).

wrong: Affordable student accomodation remains scarce near major metropolitan campuses.
correct: Affordable student accommodation remains scarce near major metropolitan campuses.
ruleVi: "Accommodation" có hai chữ "c" và hai chữ "m" (rất hay sai trong IELTS Listening & Writing).

wrong: Early literacy is widely regarded as a neccessary foundation for lifelong learning.
correct: Early literacy is widely regarded as a necessary foundation for lifelong learning.
ruleVi: "Necessary" chỉ có một chữ "c" và hai chữ "s" (1 collar, 2 sleeves).

wrong: Authorities should seperate pedestrian walkways from fast-moving urban traffic lanes.
correct: Authorities should separate pedestrian walkways from fast-moving urban traffic lanes.
ruleVi: "Separate" viết bằng "a" ở âm tiết giữa (sep-a-rate), không phải "e".

wrong: Long-term public investment is definately needed to upgrade ageing water pipes.
correct: Long-term public investment is definitely needed to upgrade ageing water pipes.
ruleVi: "Definitely" bắt nguồn từ "finite" nên viết "i", không bao giờ viết "definately".

wrong: Rapid technological shifts have occured across both manufacturing and finance.
correct: Rapid technological shifts have occurred across both manufacturing and finance.
ruleVi: Động từ "occur" nhấn âm 2 nên khi thêm "-ed" phải gấp đôi chữ "r" ("occurred").

wrong: Universities should encourage independant critical thinking rather than memorisation.
correct: Universities should encourage independent critical thinking rather than memorisation.
ruleVi: "Independent" kết thúc bằng "-ent", không phải "-ant".

wrong: Maintaining public trust requires a high level of transparancy in urban budgets.
correct: Maintaining public trust requires a high level of transparency in urban budgets.
ruleVi: "Transparency" kết thúc bằng "-ency" (từ "transparent"), không phải "-ancy".

wrong: Small rural businesses often struggle to maintain competetive export prices.
correct: Small rural businesses often struggle to maintain competitive export prices.
ruleVi: "Competitive" có chữ "i" ở giữa (com-pet-i-tive), không phải "e".

wrong: Urban planners should prioritise sustainble public transit over wider motorways.
correct: Urban planners should prioritise sustainable public transit over wider motorways.
ruleVi: "Sustainable" giữ đủ nguyên âm "a" trước "-ble" (sustain + able).

wrong: Adequate maintanance of public bridges prevents costly structural collapses.
correct: Adequate maintenance of public bridges prevents costly structural collapses.
ruleVi: "Maintenance" viết là "ten" ở giữa (main-ten-ance), khác với động từ "maintain".

wrong: Unchecked urban sprawl poses a persistant threat to surrounding farmland.
correct: Unchecked urban sprawl poses a persistent threat to surrounding farmland.
ruleVi: "Persistent" kết thúc bằng "-ent", không phải "-ant".

wrong: Many commuters choose cycling for its obvious health benifits and low cost.
correct: Many commuters choose cycling for its obvious health benefits and low cost.
ruleVi: "Benefits" viết bằng "e" ở âm tiết thứ hai (ben-e-fits), không phải "i".

wrong: Public debates over artificial intelligence often exagerate short-term job losses.
correct: Public debates over artificial intelligence often exaggerate short-term job losses.
ruleVi: "Exaggerate" có hai chữ "g" (ex-ag-ger-ate).

wrong: Effective policy reform requires genuine committment from both national and local leaders.
correct: Effective policy reform requires genuine commitment from both national and local leaders.
ruleVi: "Commitment" chỉ có một chữ "t" ở giữa (không gấp đôi "t" như "committed").

wrong: Research confirms a clear corelation between early reading habits and academic success.
correct: Research confirms a clear correlation between early reading habits and academic success.
ruleVi: "Correlation" có hai chữ "r" (cor-re-la-tion).

wrong: International trade agreements must include strict recomendations on labour safety.
correct: International trade agreements must include strict recommendations on labour safety.
ruleVi: "Recommendation" có một chữ "c" và hai chữ "m" (re-com-men-da-tion).

wrong: Online misinformation can severely dammage public confidence in clinical trials.
correct: Online misinformation can severely damage public confidence in clinical trials.
ruleVi: "Damage" chỉ có một chữ "m", không gấp đôi "m".

wrong: A growing concensus among economists favours progressive carbon taxation.
correct: A growing consensus among economists favours progressive carbon taxation.
ruleVi: "Consensus" viết bằng "s" ở giữa (con-sen-sus), không phải "c".
